description: Metadata for Center for Strategic and International Studies pages on artificial intelligence, machine learning, or AI policy. Hosts are www.csis.org and csis.org. Each URL was confirmed with one bounded GET. robots.txt disallows /admin/, /search/, and /user/login. An HTML robots document does not allow a fetch. A challenge, captcha, login wall, non-HTML shell, unresolved host, or off-host redirect stores no row. Rows are title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights. Page text, abstracts, PDFs, quotes, transcripts, and chart data are not stored. A missing date is unknown. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. creative_commons is CC0, CC BY-SA, or a permissive mix. creative_commons_attribution is CC BY alone. Not a belief collector. runner_wired is false.
